name: Target Stripe
description: Concentric rings crossed with upright stripes, figure and ground swapping wherever the two meet, so the target shimmers.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-mask: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse @calc(round(((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round(((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100) * 100) / 100)% at @calc(round(((50 - 100 * @dx)) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round(((50 - 100 * @dy)) * 100) / 100)%, #000 0 7%, transparent 7% 14%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 25%, #000 25% 50%); mask: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse @calc(round(((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round(((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100) * 100) / 100)% at @calc(round(((50 - 100 * @dx)) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round(((50 - 100 * @dy)) * 100) / 100)%, #000 0 7%, transparent 7% 14%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 25%, #000 25% 50%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @lp(); -webkit-mask: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse @calc(round(((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round(((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100) * 100) / 100)% at @calc(round(((50 - 100 * @dx)) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round(((50 - 100 * @dy)) * 100) / 100)%, transparent 0 7%, #000 7% 14%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 25%, transparent 25% 50%); mask: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse @calc(round(((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round(((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100) * 100) / 100)% at @calc(round(((50 - 100 * @dx)) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round(((50 - 100 * @dy)) * 100) / 100)%, transparent 0 7%, #000 7% 14%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 25%, transparent 25% 50%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
